The appeals have been filed challenging the impugned order dated 03.05.2018 passed by learned ASJ, Special Judge (NDPS), Rohini Courts whereby the respondents have been acquitted under Sections 498A/306 IPC.
List the matter for final hearing on 06.12.2024 at the end of the board.
DINESH KUMAR SHARMA, J SEPTEMBER 10, 2024 Pallavi/KR
